topic: Forms of Energy and Energy Transformation
key_concepts: Energy is the ability to do work or make changes
Energy is classified as kinetic or potential
Mechanical energy is possessed by moving objects
Electrical energy is carried by moving electrons
Chemical energy is stored in bonds of atoms and molecules
Heat energy is energy transferred from one body to another
Thermal energy is due to the movement of molecules
Sound energy is produced by vibrating objects
Light energy is electromagnetic radiation that can travel through empty space
Energy can change from one form to another, such as electrical to light or heat
Heat is produced during energy transformations
